acceptance_criteria: Repository builds, type-checks, and lints from a clean install on the declared Node range with no Next.js/React runtime left in production dependencies.
expected_tests: Clean checkout installs from the committed lockfile (yarn install --frozen-lockfile).
yarn build, yarn typecheck, yarn lint exit 0 with zero diagnostics.
Smoke: root route renders AppHeader and demo note against mocked server responses.
tasks.objective: Replace the Next.js shell (pages/_app.tsx, pages/_document.tsx, next.config.js, package.json) with a Nuxt 3 app: nuxt.config.ts, app.vue, strict tsconfig, eslint + prettier config derived from the existing .eslintrc.json/.prettierrc, Vitest/Vue Test Utils/Playwright setup, and CI scripts for install/build/typecheck/lint/unit/component/server-route/smoke. Preserve declared Node >=22.23.4 <23, public/ PWA assets, and styles/globals.css.

acceptance_criteria: Landing and room list pages render in Nuxt with tested success, empty, and loading states and no React/Grommet imports.
expected_tests: Component tests: room table renders from mocked /api/rooms payload, presents unique_name, id link to /rooms/[id], max participants, record audio/video.
Component tests: empty-room state shows the 'No rooms found' notice; loading state shown before the fetch resolves.
Browser smoke: landing page link navigates to the rooms page.
tasks.objective: Migrate pages/index.tsx, pages/rooms/list.tsx, and the rooms table/list UI to Vue SFC pages under pages/ (plus error.vue and 404 handling) with data-testid hooks preserved (btn-select-room), fetching /api/rooms client-side, and usable desktop and narrow-viewport layouts replacing Grommet DataTable/Box/Text markup.

acceptance_criteria: All five server routes pass success/failure/validation tests and the static scan proves browser code and emitted payloads carry no Telnyx credentials.
expected_tests: Server-route tests with a mocked upstream: success, 4xx, 5xx, missing body fields, and wrong-method (405 + Allow) for every one of the five routes.
Secret-scan test: asserted that Bearer credentials are taken only from server process.env and no route references credential string literals.
Mapping test: upstream error body message surfaces verbatim in the response, matching pages/api behavior.
tasks.objective: Implement server/api routes for room list (GET), room lookup (GET by id), join client token (POST), refresh client token (POST), and dial-out (POST) mirroring pages/api/** semantics: uuid request_id propagation, method guards returning 405 with Allow headers, body field validation, upstream status/JSON mapping, and error reporting through the ported bugsnag helper. Keep TELNYX_API_KEY, TELNYX_API_HOST, and TELNYX_CALL_CONTROL_API_HOST strictly server-side via process.env/runtimeConfig.

acceptance_criteria: The composable is covered by deterministic fake-driven unit tests proving typed events, subscription behavior, and cleanup, with no raw @telnyx/video listener registration outside the composable, and the fake + media doubles are importable by every test suite without live credentials.
expected_tests: Unit tests against the SDK fake: initialize, connect, and each of the 18 events update the exposed reactive state exactly once.
Listener accounting test: dispose() removes all registered handlers (fake listener count returns to 0) and clearInterval/clearTimeout spies report zero live timers.
Token refresh test with fake timers: refresh fires at the configured cadence only while state.status is connected.
Reconnect test: a disconnected(reason, state) network_error path surfaces the onDisconnected callback for the page-layer retry logic.
Fake contract test: the fake emits every event in the 18-event surface and subscribers receive the documented payload shape.
Double hygiene test: media fakes stop() deterministically and appear in no production import graph (only under tests/).
tasks.objective: Extract hooks/room.ts into composables/useTelnyxRoom.ts: initialization via initialize() (roomId, clientToken, context, enableMessages), connected-state subscription management (addSubscription for remote streams), presenter tracking from stream key 'presentation', active speaker and participantsByActivity computation, message recording, network-metrics report toggling, token refresh cadence (TOKEN_TTL minus 20s) calling /api/refresh_client_token, and a dispose() that removes every one of the 18 listeners, clears both timers, and disconnects the Room. Expose a typed TelnyxRoom model. Deliver together a deterministic fake of @telnyx/video (tests/fakes/telnyx-video.ts) with scriptable emission of the 18-event surface and listener add/off/inspect helpers, plus a media test double (tests/fakes/media.ts) covering getUserMedia, MediaStreamTrack stop, enumerateDevices, and a fake VideoProcessor/Camera for virtual-background tests; all doubles stay under tests/ and never enter production code paths.

acceptance_criteria: No React context modules remain, all durable meeting state lives in the store, and store unit tests prove flags, notifications, and unread messages behave as the source did.
expected_tests: Store unit tests: each state slice mutates reactively and the optional-features parser maps 'true' query strings exactly as the source does.
Action tests: sendNotification queues toasts; unread messages accumulate in arrival order.
Persistence test: username and device preferences round-trip through the localStorage helpers in utils/storage.ts.
tasks.objective: Replace contexts/TelnyxMeetContext.ts and contexts/DebugContext.ts with a Pinia store (stores/meet.ts) carrying audio/video device IDs and setters, isAudioTrackEnabled/isVideoTrackEnabled, isVideoPlaying, networkMetrics, unread messages, optional feature flags parsed from route query (audio_control, dial_out, network_metrics, simulcast, diagnostics, auto_reconnect as in pages/rooms/index.tsx), and a sendNotification action backed by a Vue toast replacing react-hot-toast.

acceptance_criteria: Join, direct-URL, permission-denial, error, and auto-reconnect flows pass component tests with mocked HTTP and media boundaries.
expected_tests: Component tests: join fetches /api/client_token only when query tokens are absent; join button disabled without roomId/username.
Component tests: NotAllowedError from the audio permission probe opens the mediaBlocked ErrorDialog path.
Component tests: with auto_reconnect=true, three network_error disconnections rejoin and the fourth gives up (MAX_RECONNECT_TIME=3).
Component tests: direct room URL with client_token and refresh_token bypasses the token API.
tasks.objective: Migrate pages/rooms/index.tsx and components/JoinRoom.tsx to pages/rooms/index.vue (plus a direct-room route at pages/rooms/[roomId].vue ported from pages/rooms/[roomId].tsx): room UUID + username form, supplied client/refresh token query support, /api/client_token fetch on join, audio permission check with ErrorDialog on denial, and auto_reconnect handling (up to MAX_RECONNECT_TIME) wired to the useTelnyxRoom onDisconnected callback.

acceptance_criteria: Pre-join preview supports toggles, device selection, simulcast constraints, and diagnostics launch with all media resources released on unmount in tests.
expected_tests: Component tests: preview renders local tracks from the fake MediaStream; toggling camera/mic changes enabled state in the meet store.
Component tests: switching audio/video input devices re-acquires media with the constraint deviceId; simulcast flag adds 1280x720 video constraints.
Cleanup test: unmount stops every fake MediaStreamTrack exactly once (no leaked tracks).
Error test: MediaDeviceErrors mapping (mediaBlocked, mediaUnknown) surfaces through the ErrorDialog path.
tasks.objective: Migrate components/MediaPreview/index.tsx, MediaControlBar.tsx, helper.tsx, and utils/userMedia.ts into a Vue preview composable (composables/useMediaPreview.ts) plus components/media-preview.vue and components/media-control-bar.vue: getUserMedia constraint building (simulcast-aware), camera/microphone toggles, input/output device menus, diagnostics launch via @telnyx/rtc-diagnostics, and media-error handling, with deterministic track start/stop.

acceptance_criteria: Every in-meeting control maps to a tested composable action and the component renders against the fake room without raw SDK imports.
expected_tests: Component tests: camera/mic toggles call updateStream on the fake room and update the meet store flags.
Component tests: device menu lists enumerate fake devices; selecting one re-acquires media with the deviceId.
Component tests: screen share adds a 'presentation' stream to the fake room; the presenter id is exposed for the layout.
Component tests: leave button invokes disconnect() and the page layer observes disconnection.
Narrow-viewport test: control bar reflows without horizontal scroll at the small breakpoint.
tasks.objective: Migrate components/RoomControls/RoomControls.tsx, DeviceMenuList.tsx, ControlButton.tsx, ChatButton.tsx, and styles.ts to components/room-controls.vue with a composables/useRoomControls.ts: camera/microphone toggles, input/output device menus (getDevices), screen share add/remove stream, mixed-audio toggle, chat open/close, participants and invite panel toggles, leave room calling the composable disconnect, and notification-driven error dialogs. Route panel widths for narrow viewports.

acceptance_criteria: Grid, presentation, and participant views render fake-driven state changes and media resources are disposed on unmount in tests.
expected_tests: Component tests: 4 fake participants populate tiles in activity order; a stream_published event for key 'presentation' switches to the presentation layout for the presenter id.
Component tests: audio_activity updates dominantSpeakerId and reorders the grid via participantsByActivity.
Component tests: VideoTrack binds a fake rendered stream and calls addSubscription for remote streams on the fake room.
Responsive test: participant grid and presentation layouts produce desktop and narrow-viewport DOM structures (table/screenshot evidence for static review).
Cleanup test: track end/unmount removes media elements and object URLs deterministically.
tasks.objective: Migrate components/Feeds.tsx, Feed/Feed.tsx, VideoTrack.tsx, AudioTrack.tsx, RoomAudio.tsx, GridLayout.tsx, ScreenSharingLayout.tsx, and ParticipantsList.tsx to Vue SFCs (components/feeds.vue, components/video-track.vue, components/audio-track.vue, components/grid-layout.vue, components/screen-sharing-layout.vue, components/participants-list.vue) driven by useTelnyxRoom state: participant/active-speaker ordering from participantsByActivity and dominantSpeakerId, presenter-driven layout switch, per-stream WebRTC stats overlay hooks, and mixed-audio rendering.

acceptance_criteria: Chat and invite/dial-out work end-to-end against the fake room and mocked server route, with username resolution and unread behavior tested.
expected_tests: Component tests: message_received appends to the room composable messages and the chat list renders sender username from participant context.
Component tests: sending a message calls the fake room sendMessage with the resolved recipients (null for broadcast).

Component tests: dial_out form validates the phone input, formats E.164, and POSTs /api/dial_out with video_room_context; success hides the form and marks the invitee connected when the fake emits participant_joined.
Component tests: unread badge clears when the chat panel is opened.
tasks.objective: Migrate components/Chat.tsx and components/InviteParticipant.tsx to components/chat.vue and components/invite-participant.vue: message list from the room composable messages, send via composable sendMessage, 1:1 vs group recipient behavior, auto-scroll and unread counts; invite flow parsing phone numbers (utils/parsePhoneNumber.ts E.164) and POSTing /api/dial_out, tracking invited participants from participant_joined (as in components/Room.tsx onParticipantJoined).

acceptance_criteria: Stats and metrics views render fake-driven data behind the feature flag, with deterministic unit and component tests.
expected_tests: Component tests: network_metrics_report state renders sender/receiver metric rows; disabled flag hides the view.
Component tests: WebRTC stats overlay calls getWebRTCStatsForStream on the fake for a participant stream and renders the result.
Unit test: bitrate formatting matches the source layout (VideoBitrate.tsx) for sample metric values.
tasks.objective: Migrate components/WebRTCStats.tsx, NetworkMetricsMonitor.tsx, and VideoBitrate.tsx to components/web-rtc-stats.vue, components/network-metrics-monitor.vue, and components/video-bitrate.vue reading getWebRTCStatsForStream and network_metrics_report state from the composable (gated by the network_metrics feature flag as in hooks/room.ts and pages/rooms/index.tsx), including the fake-driven stats table rendering.

acceptance_criteria: Browser smoke and screenshot suites pass in CI, the hygiene scan is clean, and the five documentation pages satisfy the documentation gate.
expected_tests: Playwright smoke: each flow above passes headless with no live Telnyx credentials, using the mocked upstream and SDK fake.
Screenshot suite: captures desktop and narrow-viewport states for landing, pre-join, connected meeting, participant panel, chat, presentation, and error states into a reviewable artifacts directory.
Hygiene scan: asserts .env files and credentials are git-ignored and no tracked file contains secret-bearing content.
Doc completeness check: every required doc file exists and links to source paths and test files.
tasks.objective: Add Playwright browser-smoke flows against a mocked upstream (landing, room list, join pre-join, connected meeting with fake participants, presentation, chat, error and 404 states) plus desktop and narrow-viewport screenshot captures; add CI credential-hygiene scan (no tracked secret-bearing files, no emitted secrets in logs); and document architecture, behavior parity matrix, environment and security notes, clean build instructions, test instructions, and migration decisions in docs/.
